findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_text, scan_tools, check_x402_endpoint · Private data: scan_text, scan_tools, check_x402_endpoint · Public sink: scan_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_text, scan_tools, check_x402_endpoint · Private data: scan_text, scan_tools, check_x402_endpoint · Public sink: scan_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
